text:
subject_definitions: <Subject 1> is a young female with wavy blue hair, pink eyes, and red-tipped black horns. She wears a black bustier top under a white open-front jacket with blue patterns, gold accents, and red sashes. A large golden bell hangs from her neck. She has dark gloves, brown thigh-high stockings with gold clasps, and brown-and-white boots tied with red ribbons.
summary: [reference generation]. A 15-second high-impact character PV montage for <Subject 1>, titled "Pixel Fantasy", set to an energetic 132 BPM electronic pop beat. The sequence features 15 distinct, readable shots utilizing cel-shaded anime fashion editorial styling with a palette of ice-blue, navy, white, restrained gold, and red accents. The background evolves from the original starry void to dynamic graphic stages matching her palette. Transitions include action-match cuts, occlusion cuts, ink wipes, and comic panels without body morphing. Intensity increases toward the heroic final pose.
retention_analysis: <Subject 1>: fully_preserved. The character's face, hair, eyes, horns, jewelry (bell), clothing layers, gloves, footwear, and accessories remain consistent throughout. She never speaks or sings.
detailed_description: [Shot 1] Medium full-body shot of <Subject 1> standing centered against a starry deep-blue void background; she looks directly at the camera with a calm expression. [Shot 2] Close-up on <Subject 1>'s face and upper torso; the large golden bell at her neck sways gently, reflecting light. [Shot 3] Dynamic low-angle shot of <Subject 1> from behind as she turns to the left; her blue hair flows, and the white jacket flares slightly. [Shot 4] Side profile of <Subject 1> mid-torso; a graphic ice-blue geometric shape wipes across the screen in an ink-wipe transition. [Shot 5] Extreme close-up on <Subject 1>'s pink eyes; they widen slightly as she blinks. [Shot 6] Full-body shot with <Subject 1> beginning to walk forward; her boots step on a reflective surface, creating glowing white footprints. [Shot 7] Over-the-shoulder view of <Subject 1> looking over her left shoulder toward the camera; the background shifts to navy graphic shapes. [Shot 8] Medium shot from below as <Subject 1> raises both hands in front of her chest; golden clasps on her gloves glint. [Shot 9] Action match-cut transition where <Subject 1>'s raised arms transform into a dynamic pose, body morphing slightly to match the energy. [Shot 10] Full-body shot of <Subject 1> striking a heroic stance with one leg forward; red ribbons on her boots flutter in a non-existent wind. [Shot 11] Close-up of <Subject 1>'s torso as she clenches her fists; gold accents on the jacket pulse with light. [Shot 12] Low-angle shot from behind <Subject 1> as she leaps upward; the background explodes into white and blue graphic shards. [Shot 13] Mid-shot of <Subject 1> mid-air, arms outstretched; red sashes trail behind her like ribbons. [Shot 14] Close-up on <Subject 1>'s face with a determined expression; her blue hair flows wildly in the wind. [Shot 15] Heroic final pose: full-body shot of <Subject 1> landing on the ground, arms crossed confidently; the background is a solid navy-blue graphic stage with gold and red accents framing her silhouette.
overall_soundscape: An energetic 132 BPM 4/4 instrumental electronic pop beat featuring melodic synths, punchy drums, and driving bass. Sparse whooshes and impacts are placed below the music to align with cuts and gestures. No intelligible lyrics, dialogue, or voiceover.
non_diegetic_music: The track builds tension gradually, starting with a steady synth pulse in the first few shots, introducing heavier percussion around Shot 5, and peaking with full instrumentation and sound effects at the climax and final pose.
